item.title: Beretta A300 Ultima Patrol – Now in 20 Gauge
item.description: The Beretta A300 Ultima Patrol has proven itself to be an exceptional shotgun. It is smooth shooting, reliable, and fast. item.title: AC30 B.O.B. – Over the Barrel Suppressor From Savage
item.description: One thing we all discover once we start running suppressors on full-size rifles is the overall length. This is a challenge for competition shooters, hunters, and range shooters alike. We want the benefits of shooting suppressed, but we don’t want a gun as long as a ’72 Lincoln. The team at Savage Arms has come up with a great solution. The AC30 B.O.B Over the Barrel Suppressor. item.description: If you have ever spent any serious time training with your rifle, you have undoubtedly run into a barricade or corner on your offside. item.title: Dead Air RXD910Ti –New Suppressor in the RXD Series
item.description: There are few items as nice to have on your gun as a suppressor. The ability to shoot with reduced sound makes range time much more enjoyable. Add to that the improvement in felt recoil and muzzle rise, and suppressors are a winner. The nature of suppressors also allows them to work in multiple calibers. A company that has really taken this to heart is Dead Air. Their latest suppressor to address this is the Dead Air RXD910Ti. Dead Air RXD910Ti - Dead Air / Ruger Collaboration Dead Air Silencers
